content.text:
PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP; 10 MB.

The OCR tool only accepts those image/PDF formats, and any other format (including .zip) is rejected with a 422 “Invalid file format.” The limit is a hard 10 MB per file.

[OCR tool – Supported file formats & limits](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/tools#ocr)
